relationships.subject: salivary CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: higher pretreatment salivary CGRP levels were statistically significantly associated to a higher probability of having 50% or greater reduction in headache frequency in patients with EM

relationships.subject: depressive symptoms
relationships.evidence_quote: the presence of depressive symptoms seems to increase salivary CGRP levels

key_findings: Salivary CGRP is higher in migraine and predicts erenumab response in episodic migraine; depressive symptoms raise CGRP.
